subject: Coord: East Coast demo — DST crossover week; need a reliable slot

Subject: Coord: East Coast demo — DST crossover week; need a reliable slot

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking time to evaluate Redwood. We'd love to run a 45-minute walkthrough focused on latency and routing controls for your multi-region inference patterns. Quick note: the week of Oct 26 has an EU/US DST crossover (EU clocks fall back on Sun Oct 25, US not until Nov 1), so common conversions are shifting by an hour that week. I want to avoid scheduling confusion.

Below are three options (all listed with both US/EU labels). I've attached a .ics with the options and a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) for the session. Please pick the slot that works best and I'll lock it:

- Wed, 28 Oct 2026 — 13:00 EDT / 18:00 CET (recommended; overlaps with both product engineers)
- Thu, 29 Oct 2026 — 18:30 EDT / 23:30 CET (late evening for EU; fine if your execs prefer US afternoon)
- Tue, 27 Oct 2026 — 09:00 EDT / 14:00 CET (morning ET, early afternoon Amsterdam)

If none of those work, tell us a 60-minute window that does and we'll propose a host rotation so someone from the EU engineering team is awake for the live questions (recording + follow-up Q&A is standard).

Regards,

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (212) 555-0189

Attachments: proposed_slots.ics (3 slots), MAP_Cleargrove_v1.xlsx (one-pager mutual action plan)

Hannah —

Thanks, appreciate the heads up about DST. We're in New York (ET) and I had a quick follow-up: the Tue 09:00 ET is great for our engineering leads, but our Head of Data (joining live) is in meetings until 10:30. The Wed 13:00 ET slot looks promising — I just want to double-check the EU conversion: you're saying that's 18:00 in Amsterdam after they've rolled back clocks? Just want to avoid the old mix-up where everyone thinks it's 17:00 vs 18:00.

If Wed works for you and your EU engineers can join at 18:00 CET, lock it. If not, can we do Thu 16:00 ET / 21:00 CET instead? That would be late for EU but still doable.

Also, quick ask: can you record and share slides? Our procurement folks might want the MAP to align on next steps before the demo.

Best,
Sarah Thompson
